title: Interactive SceneModel Inspector
description: Loads the Duplex IFC model and runs inspectSceneModel with both opt-in geometry checks. The InspectionReport renders into a three-tier collapsible panel (severity → issue type → individual issues); each Warnings section and per-code group carries a 'Fix all' button that dispatches through applyFixes against the registered Fix for that code. Each fix run logs into a sibling Fix Results panel — fixed / skipped / errors counts plus per-issue outcomes.
